# TheySaid 4.0: See How Users Will React, Right Where You Build
## Channel: TheySaid | AI User Testing & Synthetic Testers
23 subscribers
N/A likes

### Description
76 views
Posted: 2026-10-20
Design and code got 10x faster. Validation didn’t. So you ship on instinct and find out from the churn report.

TheySaid 4.0 closes that gap. It puts user tests directly inside the tools you already build in, including Lovable, Replit, v0, Bolt, Claude Design, Jira, Monday.com, and ClickUp.

🚀 What’s new in 4.0 [...] ✅ Ticket Testing: Automatically triggers validation when Jira tickets hit “design done.”
✅ Unified Test Builder: Tests, interviews, surveys, and polls, all in one interface.
✅ UI 4.0: A completely redesigned experience.
✅ Screeners: Make sure the right people take your test.
✅ Mobile Website Testing: Test your site on mobile browsers.
✅ Mobile App Testing: Test native apps on Android and iOS.
✅ Clips & Highlight Reels: Pull the key moments and share them with your team.
✅ Advanced Intercepts: Capture feedback at key moments in the product experience.
✅ Auto-Translation: Collect and understand feedback in any language.
✅ Intro Videos: Set the context for participants before they start.
✅ Response Quality Monitor: Flag low-quality responses so you can trust your results. [...] ✅ Synthetic Audiences: Custom audiences that act like real customers. They follow instructions, share their screen, and speak aloud.
✅ Audiences: Create human and synthetic customer audiences that MCP uses to gather evidence from the right people. Compare insights between audiences, and make sure validation happens with the audiences that matter.
✅ AI Companion: Works like Claude Design or Claude Code. Tell it what to do, and it does the work.
✅ Experience Intelligence Dashboard: Monitors and scores your critical customer experiences, then recommends how to improve them.
✅ Skills: Reusable prompts for in-product work like executive summaries and cohort analysis.
✅ TheySaid MCP: Instant feedback and fix prompts on designs built in Claude Design, v0, Replit, Bolt, and Lovable.

results.title: How to Set Up a User Test in TheySaid (Step-by-Step)
results.content:
## Start testing in minutes

That’s the whole setup: describe your test, let AI write it, polish it in the Builder, and publish. In under two minutes, you’ll have a live, AI-moderated test running with real users, synthetic audiences, or both.

And this is only the start of what’s new in TheySaid 4.0. Write your own Skills with the AI Companion, launch tests right where you build in tools like Claude Design, and turn every session into clear, evidence-backed next steps, plus so much more.

Ready to see how users will react? Get started for free and run your first test today.

Read How to Analyze User Testing Results in TheySaid to turn every session into clear findings and next steps.

## FAQs [...] Can I use my own voice for the AI moderator? Yes. Go to Moderator Voice, record a short sample of yourself reading one sentence, pick a mood (Neutral, Warm, Professional, or Energetic), and save it. TheySaid builds the voice in under a minute, and you can make it the default for all your tests.

Can I launch a TheySaid test from my design tool? Yes. With TheySaid 4.0, you can plan and launch a test right where you build. In Claude Design, for example, you can ask Claude to write a test plan for your prototype and launch it in TheySaid without leaving your design.

## Explore Insights & Ideas

Discover expert insights, company news, and practical tips to help you turn feedback into action.

User Testing

Can Synthetic Testers Shop Like Humans? Dyson vs. Shark Case Study

by

Chris

| [...] The Builder has two main areas:

 The preview (center) shows exactly what participants will see. Use the Preview / Logic toggle at the top to switch between how the test looks and how questions branch.
 The Build panel (right) lists every item in order, labeled by type. Click any item to edit it, or drag it to reorder.

At the top of the Build panel, you'll find a Screener block. Turn it on to ask a few qualifying questions before the test starts, so only the right people take part. At the bottom, the Outro holds your closing message, like Thank you for taking this test!
